abilities.name: Infantry Armor
abilities.text: Use before a Friendly Biological Unit makes an Armour Roll. That Unit gains TOUGH (1) for this roll.

abilities.name: Infantry Weapons
abilities.text: The active Biological Unit's first Ranged Weapon used gains CRITICAL HIT (1).
